COMPANY PROFILE

COMPANY PROFILE
EGYPT’S LEADING POP-UP
MARKETPLACE 
Bazarna Pop-Up Society is Egypt’s leading pop-up marketplace
incubator, shaping local talent since 2010.
More than a marketplace, Bazarna is a movement, where
creativity, business, and community come together. We curate
immersive pop-up experiences that connect emerging fashion,
lifestyle, and homegrown brands with conscious consumers.
By empowering businesses to launch, grow, and thrive, Bazarna
has helped reshape local shopping culture, championing “Made in
Egypt” and turning it into a source of pride. Today, Bazarna stands
as a trusted name in Egypt and the MENA region, driving cultural
impact and sustainable growth.
incubator
ABOUT BAZARNA

EVERY GREAT MOVEMENT
BEGINS WITH A SPARK
For Bazarna, that spark ignited in 2010, when a young founder set
out to change how local talent was seen and supported in Egypt.
Inspired by her mother’s simple act of selling handmade silk
scarves, she transformed an empty apartment into a space where
designers could finally be seen, heard, and celebrated. It was here
that emerging creatives, some now among Egypt’s most
recognized names, presented their work for the very first time, like
Sara ElEmary.
Bazarna redefined the meaning of a bazaar, creating a platform
built for local creators to grow. At its heart, Bazarna is more than a
marketplace, it is a community, a belief in local creativity, and a
commitment to empowering the stories behind every product.
How did it all start?

THE MARKET
BAZARNA’s flagship pop-up market is where shopping meets
excitement. Medium-to-large in scale, it’s designed for
discovery, connection, and unforgettable experiences. Our
community of brand owners and shoppers knows The

It’s not just a market, it’s the ultimate destination where

Large-scale exhibitions where hundreds of talents gain visibility,

A premium, storytelling-led platform designed to spotlight

MEET THE FOUNDER
Yasmine Medhat is a 38-year-old Egyptian entrepreneur and mother of
three, and the founder of Bazarna Pop-Up Society, a pioneering platform
established in 2010 to empower and support local talents, startups, and
entrepreneurs. Through Bazarna, she has built a powerhouse community
bringing together creatives, industries, and consumers, nurturing the
brands of tomorrow with purpose, passion, and integrity.
A graduate of the American University in Cairo with a bachelor’s degree
in Integrated Marketing Communication and a minor in Art, Yasmine has
dedicated her career to supporting the local industry while actively
promoting equality, inclusivity, and sustainable growth. Her work and
leadership have been recognized by multiple organizations. Driven by
impact and community building, Yasmine continues to shape
meaningful platforms that empower creatives and create lasting value.

BAZARNA FEATURED

After years of building Bazarna’s community, loyalty, and
strong base of local brands, the 2026 retail expansion is a
natural evolution. We have spent years researching the retail
market and continuously testing it through our pop-up
experiences, allowing us to refine the model, understand
consumer behavior, and validate demand before committing
to a permanent platform. The expansion transforms Bazarna’s
market DNA into an ongoing retail experience curated
categories, rotating brands, and discovery-led journeys that
bring the best of the local market to consumers year-round.
Introducing multiple retail concepts allows us to diversify
experiences across brand positioning and audiences: a
flagship Bazarna concept reflecting the full market experience,
The Store for more established and high-end brands, and a
youth-focused concept designed to engage Gen Z.
